arrest_policy: Post-entry contact-stable stop in any supported orientation within3s; at least one original right fingertip mechanically brakes against native lane support. Right-arm braking remains continuous while left-arm outer-race grasp establishes strong bilateral pickup before brake withdrawal, free lift and recovery.

handoff.policy: Side entry above intact chute guides; continuous right brake until measured strong left outer-race grasp, narrow vertical brake withdrawal then clear park.

capture_geometry: Original fingertip reach and42mm reference height target the original outer race. Actual failedSDF trace/FK has submicrometer tool agreement and shows fingers remain axially outside the part during interception;28mm/s closure is below the38mm/s native cap and compensates observed closing delay. Native contact/penetration checks remain required.

tray_retention_stability.scope: Free released bearing remains on the actual tray floor, inside its complete usable region and without hand contact throughout a measured0.5s pose window. Actual pose variation is evaluated directly, separately from the unchanged arrest/lift windows; raw constraint-step velocities remain logged.

recovery_control: Continue bounded closing toward source20N native effort cap during loaded motion, instead of freezing a contact-onset position target. Original0.04m/s and all geometry/deadlines retained.

arrest_pose_stability.scope: Continuous measured pose window with native lane support and at least one real braking fingertip contact; separate strong bilateral left-hand pickup remains mandatory. Raw contact-step velocities are logged diagnostics, not zero-motion claims.

retained_grasp.provenance: Original35mm bearing radius + original12.57mm fingertip reach + contact/edge clearance. A round bearing may pivot/settle along the original fingers; native bilateral contacts and whole-part lift/retention remain required.

machine_outfeed.scope: Original free bearing transports from the supplied left machine opening on a native conveyor, settles at the native metering gate, then rolls into the unchanged safety/capture zone. No product writes after reset.

assumptions: Candidate0.35kg bearing/friction and original8.2deg gravity lane. Native lifting upstream gate sets release time; no product pose/velocity writes after reset. Camera/quality limits are demo settings, not certified safety limits.
scoring: Measured leading-edge zone entry to native stable arrest wholly inside safety zone within3s; separate released whole-bearing tray retention.
